crossRefs.note: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

translations.web: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
translations.bsb: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
translations.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
translations.asv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
